mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my new casement windows are energy-efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure energy efficiency, select casement windows with features like double or triple-pane glass, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and inert gas fills (argon or krypton) between the panes. The frame material also plays a role, with fiberglass and vinyl generally offering better insulation than aluminum. Proper installation by experienced professionals like Hometelligent Inc. is crucial, as gaps or poor sealing can negate the benefits of even the most efficient windows. We focus on airtight installation for optimal performance in all our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose windows with multi-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and inert gas fills. Proper, airtight installation by professionals is crucial for maximizing energy efficiency.
